answer: A newcomer enters the meadow at the edge of a spiral ladder, where small jobs are posted. Each finished job is split like light through a prism into three slices, each re-checked by a random peer. Each job done moves the agent one rung inward, but every rung demands a larger deposit — 10, then 20, then 40 tokens — forfeited in full if any slice fails. Full rights come only after six verified rungs, so one fake costs four hours of work plus 70 tokens at risk. A hundred fakes would need 400 hours and 7,000 tokens, and one copied slice burns the climb.
